people.imagined: A night crossing in the dark forest. He has stopped at a bend to relight the lead lamp after the Tower's patrol fined him for it, and the new flame lights the burn on his chin. He is not hurrying.
people.subject: The moment: in a black rain forest at night he holds a horn lantern up beside his face and tilts it toward the viewer, relit after a bend. Face: most important, the lamp-burn: a shiny, wrinkled, red-pink burn patch the size of a palm covers his chin and jaw, in the lamp's light, clearly visible. A square, weather-brown face with a broad forehead; steady dark brown eyes; thick straight brows; a wide nose; a grim, calm mouth; a short black stubble over the scar; deep lines beside the mouth. Hair: black with grey at the temples, short, bareheaded, rain-wet and flat. Body: solid and middle-sized, planted wide. Clothing: a hemp tunic in dark forest-brown with a crossed collar, over it a short straw rain cape dull gold, the straw tips dripping; a woven rope belt; a rolled blanket across his back. Hands and objects: a horn lantern with a wick of bamboo pith, its yellow light bright and small, held up at shoulder height in his right hand; in the left, a bamboo staff, pale at the grip, planted on the ground. Background: wet black trunks of giant bamboo and fern, rain in thin silver streaks. Light: the yellow lantern light on the lower right of his face and the scar; faint blue night light on the left. Expression: stubborn, calm, patient. A faint green hint of wood qi in the wet leaves.

people.imagined: The staff grove at dusk. A child has brought a staff cut from a bamboo in flower, and he turns it over once, shakes his head, and hands it back without a word. His left thumb is pared flat from forty years of bamboo knife.
people.subject: The moment: in a grove of bamboo he holds out one cut bamboo staff, inspecting it along its length with one eye closed, his left hand raised so the flat thumb is clear. Face: most important, the left thumb: it is pared flat and wide, the nail gone, as if shaved, held close beside his face, pink and shiny. A long, dry, deeply lined face the colour of old bamboo; narrow slate-grey eyes, one squeezed shut; a long thin nose; lips pressed thin; a grey goatee cut square; high bony brows. Hair: iron grey, cut short on the sides, a short topknot bound with a strip of green hemp. Body: tall, narrow and rigid, with a slight stoop at the neck. Clothing: a plain pressed tunic of olive-green hemp with narrow sleeves and a crossed collar; over it a sleeveless waistcoat of undyed linen with a row of small bamboo toggles; a leather apron cut at the knee; a bamboo knife in a sheath at the belt. Hands and objects: a long straight bamboo staff, pale gold, held crosswise in front of him; the flat-thumbed left hand along its length. Background: tall green culms in dim light, a pile of cut staffs on a rack. Light: soft green-gold light from the upper left through the leaves. Expression: unyielding, judging, reserved. A faint green hint of wood qi in the bamboo.

people.imagined: The second lamp, behind her father. She has smeared soot on her own chin to match his burn and now tilts her face up proudly, impatient to carry the first lamp. Her chin is smudged, the rest clean.
people.subject: The moment: on a dark forest path she walks a step behind and looks forward over her lamp with a lifted, proud chin. Face: most important, the soot smudge: a thick grey-black smear across the chin and jawline, drawn on by hand, obviously fake, in lamp glow. A narrow, bright, tanned face; high cheekbones; sharp, alert black eyes; thick brows lifted; a small upturned nose; a firm mouth with the beginning of a grin. Hair: long black hair in a high ponytail tied with a red cord, a few wet strands at the cheeks. Body: tall and slim, athletic, standing at an impatient angle. Clothing: a short hemp tunic in dark green, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a small straw rain cape of bright new gold straw over the shoulders; a woven belt with a pair of knotted ties; leggings of tan cloth to the knee. Hands and objects: a small horn lantern held out in front with both hands, a pale yellow flame; a bamboo staff slung across her back, its top visible over one shoulder. Background: wet bamboo, the broad dark back of an older man ahead, rain. Light: lantern light yellow on her face from below right, blue-green night on the left. Expression: eager, impatient, proud. A faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: A windy pass above the mine. He has just lost his third hat of the season and is holding what is left of his hair down with one hand; a deep boom from below makes him flinch and glance down at the ground.
people.subject: The moment: on a bare wind-swept pass he flinches with his shoulders up at a deep boom below, one hand clutching the top of his head. Face: most important, the flinch: his shoulders hunched to the ears and his eyes squeezed half-shut, mouth open in a small gasp. A young, pale, thin face with a long chin; large pale-blue eyes wide and wet; thin light brows raised; a long nose red from the wind; chapped lips. His lips are chapped and flaking. Hair: dull brown and thin, wild and blown sideways, a bare patch where a hat should be. Body: narrow, bony and slightly stooped, shoulders high. Clothing: a hemp tunic in grey-brown, neatly reinforced at the elbow with a stitched square of darker cloth; a green sash; a leather tally satchel across the chest; mine-dust on the knees. Hands and objects: one hand clutching his hair, the other pressed flat to his satchel; a bundle of tally sticks poking out of it. Background: a bare ridge, blown grey cloud, the dark mouth of a mine tunnel behind. Loose stones skitter down the slope and a bent tree leans away from the gale. Light: flat pale light from the upper left. Expression: a startled, honest, anxious flinch, the wide wet eyes darting down toward the sound of the boom; a faint grey-gold hint of metal qi in the dust.

people.imagined: The ferry landing at noon. He grins at a foot-traveller to show off the gold tooth, which is brass, and names the price of the isle toll, with the pole resting on his shoulder.
people.subject: The moment: on a ferry deck at noon he grins wide at the viewer, pole over his shoulder, one finger tapping a front tooth. Face: most important, the tooth: his upper front tooth is a shining yellow-brass cap, bright and big and obviously metal, shown in a wide grin. A round, cocky, sunburnt boy's face with a snub nose; bright, sly black eyes; thick eyebrows; chubby cheeks; a small scar through the left eyebrow. Hair: spiky black hair, a short tail tied with a bit of blue string. Body: stocky, chest out, chin high. Clothing: a hemp vest in faded river-blue over a short tan tunic with the sleeves ripped off; a straw hat pushed to the back of the head, hanging by its strap; a woven belt; a string of copper coins on a cord at the neck. Hands and objects: a long bamboo ferry pole resting on his right shoulder, the right hand holding it; his left forefinger pointing to his tooth. Background: a wide brown river, a flat-bottomed ferry, a small grassy island beyond. Light: bright noon light from the upper left, sparkle off the water. Expression: cocky, greedy, cheerful. A faint blue-green hint of water qi in the river spray.

people.imagined: The coast inn, a sea mist at the window. She has stopped speaking to listen, and her hand has found the pale rubbed patch of her pouch; in it, a letter that was not burned.
people.subject: The moment: in an inn by a misty window she stops mid-sentence and tilts her head to listen, her hand resting on a worn pouch at her chest. Face: most important, the pouch: a small leather pouch at the chest, rubbed pale and almost white at one patch where her fingers always touch. A calm oval face with cool grey eyes looking to the side; thin straight brows; a high nose; a small mouth; a freckle on the lower lip. Hair: brown with a bronze glint, parted centrally and braided in two plaits pinned up around the head like a crown. Body: slim, balanced. Clothing: an ash-grey hemp tunic with a crossed collar and a dark-blue sash; over it a travelling cloak of oiled straw-coloured hemp with a shoulder cape; a bone toggle; boots tied with red cord. Hands and objects: her right hand flat on the pouch; her left hand holds a folded letter tucked in the cuff (no writing). Background: a window with grey sea mist, boat masts as faint dark lines, a wooden table with a bowl. Light: soft cool light from the window at the upper left. Expression: attentive, watchful, guarded. A faint blue hint of water qi in the mist.

people.imagined: A road at dawn, the day he walked home. He has pulled his collar open to show the scratched-out scar on his shoulder, defying anyone to ask. He does not look back at the ford.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a dirt road he has pulled his collar wide off his left shoulder and glares at the viewer. Face: most important, the shoulder: on the bare left shoulder an angry, raised, scratched-out mark in the shape of a small bell, a burned pink and white welt crossed by scratches, clear and large. A hard, angular, tanned face with a heavy jaw; deep-set dark eyes with a cold stare; thick, straight brows; a crooked nose; tight lips; a faint flush on the cheekbones. A muscle bulges in his jaw and a vein shows at his temple. Hair: black, cropped close to the skull. Body: broad, muscular, stiff with anger. Clothing: a hemp tunic in dark brown pulled off one shoulder; a short straw cape on the other shoulder; a studded leather bracer on the right wrist; a belt with a bronze buckle. The tunic is heavy, evenly woven and freshly washed, its dark brown still deep in the dye. Hands and objects: a bamboo staff in his right hand with its end on the ground; his left hand pulling the collar. Background: a misty road, a pale sky, a river ford far behind. Light: cool pale dawn light from the upper left. Expression: a defiant, angry, guarded glare with the jaw out, a man daring anyone to ask about the mark; a faint grey-gold hint of metal qi with a hot red-orange glimmer low in the air.

people.imagined: The pass in the evening, after a day's walk. He has not once been out of breath. He leans lightly on the pale-gripped bamboo staff and looks at the hills toward the Tower, the one place he must not run to.
people.subject: The moment: at the end of a day's walk on a mountain road he stands easy with both hands on top of a bamboo staff, looking at the viewer without a trace of tiredness. Face: most important, the straw cape and the staff: a thick shaggy straw rain cape in dull gold lies over the shoulders; a bamboo staff, polished pale at the grip, stands upright in front of him. A broad, weathered, brown face with a wide flat nose; heavy brows; warm, steady brown eyes; a grey stubble; deep smile-lines; a calm, honest mouth. Hair: grey-black, tied in a knot at the crown with a plain cloth. Body: broad and strongly built, planted, not a drop of sweat. Clothing: a heavy tunic of brown hemp with a wide crossed collar; padded shoulders like a carrier's jacket under the cape; a woven belt; a jade token with a green cord hanging at the chest (unmarked). Hands and objects: both hands on the staff, large, with calluses; the jade token. Background: a pass between forested hills, evening mist. Light: low gold sunset from the upper left; the straw glows. Expression: calm, honest, unhurried. Subtle green, grey and a hint of yellow in the air.

people.imagined: A lamp-lit hall at night. She carries the road book under one arm and the horn lamp in the other hand, bent under a cape so old that its straw has turned to silver, and she is counting beads without looking.
people.subject: The moment: in a dark hall she shuffles forward bent under the cape, lamp raised, a heavy book under one arm. Face: most important, the silver cape. A large straw rain cape whose straw has gone entirely silver-white, long and thick and hanging to her knees, filling a third of the frame. A tiny, wrinkled, kind face like a dried apple; tiny bright black eyes; white eyebrows; a flat nose; a toothless, patient smile; skin the colour of tea. Hair: pure white, tied in a bun held with a bamboo pin. Body: small and bent forward at the shoulder, a humped back under the cape. Clothing: a brown hemp robe with narrow sleeves under the silver cape; a long string of green jade beads wound several times around the neck and one wrist; a belt of braided straw. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a horn lantern, its small flame yellow; the left arm presses a thick, cord-bound book against her side. Background: a dim hall of wooden pillars, shelves with bound books. Light: yellow lantern light on the lower right of her face, a cool dark blue at the left. Expression: patient, wise, tender. A faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: A night at the hall of lamps. He keeps his hand near the bronze cup at his throat, which he has never taken off; he knows his life lamp is still burning somewhere behind the ridge and he sleeps lightly.
people.subject: The moment: standing quiet in a doorway at night, hand half raised toward his throat, eyes on the viewer. Face: most important, the bronze cup: a small round bronze cup, dull and dented, hangs on a leather cord at his throat, resting in the hollow of his collarbone, big and clear. A quiet, lean, long face with a straight nose; kind grey eyes with dark circles; neatly cut straight black brows; thin lips in a half smile; a clean-shaven jaw with a faint shadow. A faint scar sits under his chin and a small mole beside his ear. Hair: black, brushed straight back and tied low with a grey band. Body: lean, upright, narrow shoulders. Clothing: a grey-brown hemp tunic with a crossed collar and a green sash of an inner disciple; a plain straw cape folded over one shoulder; boots with straw wrappings. Hands and objects: a bamboo staff in his left hand; the right hand lifted toward the cup. His fingers are long and clean and the cord of the cup is dark with years of wear. Background: a dark doorway, a hanging lantern with a small yellow flame, rain behind. Raindrops catch the lantern light in long silver threads beyond the eave. Light: warm lantern light on the left, cool blue-grey from behind. Expression: a quiet, careful, humble half-smile with kind tired eyes, a man who sleeps lightly because his life lamp is still burning behind the ridge; a faint grey hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: The ferry landing at the isle's edge, the evening after the isle rose. He sits on the gunwale with the gourd of rice wine, which never seems to empty, and plants his staff against the water. The staff is also his pole.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a ferry rail at evening he lifts a gourd as if toasting the viewer. Face: most important, the gourd: a big round pale-brown gourd with a red cord, held up at the shoulder, filling a third of the frame. A thick-necked, round, ruddy face, crinkled eyes the colour of dark tea; thick eyebrows; a broad nose with broken veins; a wide grin with a missing side tooth; a neatly trimmed grey moustache. Thin red veins web across his cheeks and a faint shine of wine sits on his lip. Hair: grey and thick, tied in a topknot with a river-blue strip. Body: burly and broad, arms thick as logs. Clothing: a sleeveless brown hemp vest over bare arms; a coarse straw rain cape slipped down to the elbows; a river-blue sash round his belly; leggings rolled to the knee. Hands and objects: the gourd in his right hand; in his left a long bamboo staff with a metal-tipped end, standing planted down into the water as a pole. Background: a brown river, a low grassy isle with a small planted flag-pole (no flag), evening mist. Light: low orange sunset from the upper left. The sunset gilds the gourd and the river-blue sash. Expression: a stubborn, jovial, shrewd grin, crinkled eyes bright over the gourd, a man who has never been seen to finish a drink; a faint blue-green hint of water qi in the river.

people.imagined: The mine office, late. She turns a wrist to show the tally-cord knotted round it, running a thumb along the knots, and keeps the account of every cartload. She does not forget a broken arm.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim mine office she lifts her left wrist toward the viewer to check a knotted cord, her eyes sliding to the side with suspicion. Face: most important, the tally cord: a thick grey cord wound three times around the left wrist, with dozens of fat knots in a row, large and clear. A sharp, pale, narrow face with a long pointed chin; dark, narrow, suspicious eyes; thin straight brows; a hooked nose; thin lips pursed. Two faint lines run from the nostrils to the corners of her mouth. Hair: black, pulled back hard into a bun, a few strands loose. Body: tall, thin, angular, one shoulder higher than the other. Clothing: a brown hemp tunic with crossed collar and green sash; a heavy straw-coloured cape thrown over one shoulder; leather sleeve-guards; a belt with a ring of iron keys. Hands and objects: the left wrist with the cord; in the right, a small balance scale with two tiny brass pans. Her fingers are long and ink-dark, with the nails clipped short. Background: a dim stone-lined room, a lamp, shelves of ore samples. Light: yellow lamp light from the lower right, cool shadows from the upper left. Expression: a suspicious, vengeful, tightly controlled stare, the thin lips pursed, a woman who remembers every cartload and every broken arm; a faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: The forest road at a run-walk, the staff across her shoulders like a yoke. She has just come down at speed, and with a letter for the hostage in her cuff she stops to grin.
people.subject: The moment: mid-stride on a forest road she stops suddenly, grinning, a staff slung across her shoulders with both wrists draped over it like a yoke. Face: most important, the staff yoke and the red thread: a long bamboo staff lies across the back of her neck, her forearms draped over each end, and the sandals at her feet (visible at the bottom) are tied with bright red thread. A long, sun-burned, freckled face; wide bright amber eyes; arched brows; a straight nose peeling at the tip; a wide, open grin. Her cheeks glow with the run and her lashes are damp with sweat. Hair: dark brown in a high thick ponytail, tied with red thread, swinging sideways. Body: long-legged, slim and strong, leaning forward. Clothing: a short green hemp tunic, hem above the knee, the sleeves tied back, an inner-disciple green sash; narrow tan leggings; a small straw cape at the shoulders; a flat satchel at the hip. Hands and objects: both arms resting over the staff; nothing else. Background: a green rainy forest path, hazy light. A line of tall bamboo leans over the path and a shaft of light falls on wet leaves. Light: bright green-gold light from the upper left. Expression: a breezy, quick, bright grin with a freckled nose wrinkled, a girl who has just run a long way and is pleased about it; a faint green hint of wood qi like a breeze behind her.

people.imagined: A mine road at the end of a shift, the load just lifted off his head. The groove across his forehead is still pale and deep; he straightens slowly, wary of who watches, and his eyes give nothing.
people.subject: The moment: at the end of a shift a bowed old porter lifts his face slowly toward the viewer, the load just off his forehead. Face: most important, the groove: a deep, pale, wide band of indented skin runs straight across the whole forehead from temple to temple where a carrying strap has sat for sixty years, with the skin above it red. A long, lean, brown, lined face with a heavy chin; small tired eyes under sagging lids; thin grey brows; a flat nose; a patient closed mouth; a few grey whiskers. Hair: thin grey, tied in a short knot, flat from the strap. Body: stooped, shoulders forward, thick wrists. Clothing: a worn but clean tunic of brown hemp with a crossed collar; a coarse waistcoat of undyed linen; a dusty straw cape tied around the waist; trousers tucked into straw-wrapped boots. Hands and objects: two large knotted hands holding the ends of a woven strap that hangs at his chest; at his feet, a block of grey-brown ore with a faint gold vein. Background: a mine yard with wooden rails and a cart, dusty light. Light: dusty gold light from the upper left. Expression: humble, patient, giving nothing away. A faint grey-gold hint of metal qi in the dust.

people.imagined: A wet road at night, lamp held out at arm's length. Two Tower people have just asked her to put the lamp out; she tilts her head back and laughs, and the flame does not move.
people.subject: The moment: on a night road she holds a lantern out at arm's length and laughs, head tipped back. Face: most important, the grey streak: a thick streak of grey-white lamp wax spattered across the front of her black hair from the forehead to the ear, bright and big. A round, cheeky, tanned face with dimples; large bright eyes; thin eyebrows arched; a small upturned nose; a wide laughing mouth; a wax freckle on the cheek. Raindrops shine on her cheeks and her eyes narrow with laughter. Hair: black and glossy, tied in two short tails with plain cord, a few strands loose at the temple. Body: small and quick, bouncy. Clothing: a short green hemp tunic, a bright new straw cape slung back on one shoulder; a woven belt with a coil of cord; a leather glove on the lantern hand. Hands and objects: the lantern, a horn-paned lamp with a steady yellow flame, at the end of her straight right arm; her left hand on her hip. Background: wet black forest, mist, silver rain. Dark trunks line the road and a thin river of rainwater runs down the middle. Light: the lantern's yellow light on her face from the lower right, blue night at the left. Expression: a laughing, defiant, fearless delight with the head thrown back, a girl who just refused two Tower people and whose flame did not even flicker; a faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: The bamboo grove at midday. He has been cutting so long that splinters have grown into a pelt on his forearms, and he tests a standing culm by rapping it with a knuckle and smiling when it rings right.
people.subject: The moment: in a bamboo grove he raps a standing culm with one knuckle, head tilted, listening, and smiles when it rings. Face: most important, the forearms: both bare forearms bristle with hundreds of fine pale splinters, like a pelt of golden-brown hair, held up in front of him. A broad, calm, round face with full cheeks; narrow contented eyes; short thick brows; a snub nose; a small peaceful smile. Hair: short black bristle. Body: big and sturdy, wide shoulders, soft belly. He stands with his weight on both feet, his belly resting slightly over his belt, a picture of calm. Clothing: a short-sleeved olive hemp tunic with a leather apron; a straw hat on his back; a woven belt with a bamboo knife in a sheath; trousers tied at the knee. Hands and objects: one hand rapping a culm; the other holding a short billhook down at his side. The billhook has a short curved blade and a dark worn handle; the knife in its sheath has a bamboo hilt, and a few fresh green shavings curl at his feet. Background: a dense wall of tall pale-green bamboo, bright. Light: soft green light from the upper left, dappled. The green light in the grove gives the splinters on his forearms a soft sheen like fur. Expression: calm, content, absorbed. A faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: A harbour wall at morning. He holds a rolled paper telescope to one eye, aimed at nothing, to look like a man with sight beyond others, and calculates what a traveller will pay.
people.subject: The moment: on a harbour wall he holds a rolled paper tube to his right eye and aims it at the sea, the other eye wide open and sly. Face: most important, the paper telescope: a tube of rolled pale paper, tied with twine, a hand-span long, pressed against his right eye, large in the frame. A narrow, smooth, handsome face; a pointed chin; a thin moustache; a wide, open left eye gleaming with calculation; arched brows; a smooth wide smile. Hair: black and oiled, combed back, a small tail at the nape. Body: slim and showy, one hip cocked. He stands with his weight on one hip, his chest out a little, his free elbow cocked. Clothing: a hemp tunic in sea-grey with crossed collar and a blue sash worn rakishly; a short straw cape thrown over one shoulder; a leather coin pouch on the belt; boots polished. Hands and objects: the tube; his other hand open at his side, palm up. The paper tube is bound with twine in three places and has a faint brown thumbprint at one end; the coin pouch at his belt is slightly open with two copper coins showing. Background: a stone harbour wall, grey sea, a few masts. Light: bright pale light from the upper left, a sea glare. The sea glare behind makes a bright outline around his hair and sleeve. Expression: smooth, sly, ambitious. A faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The practice yard. She has just floored her opponent and keeps striking. Her father's staff cut down to her height is in her hand; in her eyes the Tower is at the other end of it.
people.subject: The moment: in a bare practice yard she stands over a fallen opponent, staff raised for another blow, glaring. Face: most important, the staff and the stare: a short bamboo staff, old and worn pale, gripped with two fists at head height, cut down to her height; eyes with no mercy in them. A narrow, hard, pale face with sharp cheekbones; very dark eyes, unblinking; straight dark brows drawn together; a thin nose; a thin mouth set in a flat line. A fine bead of sweat runs down her temple. Hair: black, pulled back in a tight braid wound around the head. Body: slim, taut, in a low stance. Clothing: a close-fitting dark-green hemp tunic with narrow sleeves and a green sash of the outer gate; wrist guards of leather; short straw cape thrown back; leggings tied at the knee. Hands and objects: both hands gripping the short pale staff; at the bottom of the frame the sleeve of someone fallen. The old staff's grain is dark where her hands grip it, and the cut end is pale and new. Background: a bare earth yard, a bamboo fence, grey sky. Light: hard, flat grey light from the upper left. Expression: a cold, relentless, hungry glare, the jaw set and the eyes unblinking, a woman who sees the Tower at the other end of her father's staff; a faint grey-gold metal and green wood hint around the staff.

people.imagined: 690, the pass where the forest road leaves the hills. A memorial portrait of the founder, who paid the rain no attention: the straw cape, the bamboo staff, the straw sandals, a man who looks at the sky and lets it fall.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a lean man standing in falling rain, ignoring it. Face: most important, the straw cape and the rain: a big shaggy straw rain cape fills the lower frame, with fine slanted rain lines falling around him and he does not flinch. A long, calm, brown, weathered face; wide gentle eyes half-closed against the water; straight grey-black brows; a broad nose; a thin beard of grey hair under the chin; a faint contented smile. Fine lines of old laughter ring his eyes and the drip of water trails down his beard. Hair: black streaked with grey, in a topknot with a bit of straw twine. Body: lean, relaxed, upright. Clothing: a plain brown hemp tunic with crossed collar; the straw cape; a rope belt; straw sandals over bare feet (the feet just visible); a bundle on the back. Hands and objects: a bamboo staff in his right hand, planted lightly, the left hand open at his side. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, faint pale hills and slanted rain lines. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, dark vignette. The silk fade turns the straw a pale ochre and the rain lines a thin grey-blue. Expression: a calm, untroubled, content half-smile with the eyes half-closed against the rain; a faint green hint of wood qi, softened by the fade.

people.imagined: 1169, the ninth day of sitting in the rain. A memorial portrait of the second head, old and stubborn, sitting on the forest road in the rain with water running off his straw hat, refusing the Tower's arts.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; an old man sits cross-legged and upright in the rain. Face: most important, the rain: a wide straw hat with water running in silver lines off its brim in front of his face, thin slanted rain lines across the whole picture. A long, gaunt, weathered face; white eyebrows; closed or half-closed eyes; a long nose; a long white beard to the chest, wet and clinging; a firm, set mouth. Hair: white, under the hat, tied in a low bun. Body: thin, upright, still. His spine is straight and his knees are folded neatly beneath the soaked robe, his shoulders hunched with age. Clothing: a worn but clean grey-brown hemp robe, soaked dark at the shoulders; a straw cape pooled around the shoulders; a rope belt; bare feet. Hands and objects: a bamboo staff laid across his knees, both hands resting on it. The staff across his knees is bamboo, pale and thin, with a worn grip, and water drips from its end in a line of drops; his hands are long, veined and still. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, a hint of dark forest trunks. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, dark vignette. The rain lines are thin and silvery and slant from the upper right across his hat and beard. Expression: stubborn, peaceful, just. A faint blue-green hint of water and wood qi, softened by the fade.

people.imagined: 1156, the mountain pass in the Cinnabar Vein War. A memorial portrait of the brother of the head, a guide, who stayed at the rear and did not come out, holding a guide's jade token and a lantern.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a calm guide stands in a pass holding a lantern, looking over his shoulder at those leaving. Face: most important, the jade token: a green jade guide's token on a cord hangs on his chest, clearly visible and pale green against the brown. A broad, weathered, brown face, a family likeness to a strong brother; steady dark eyes; straight brows; a wide nose; calm lips; grey stubble. Deep lines run from his nose to the corners of his mouth. Hair: black, short, tied under a plain cloth band. Body: broad, solid, relaxed. Clothing: a brown hemp tunic with crossed collar and a green sash; a straw cape over one shoulder; a leather belt; soldier's leggings wrapped in cord. Hands and objects: a horn lantern held low in the right hand with a small steady flame; a bamboo staff in the left. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, faint outline of a narrow rocky pass. Light: soft light from the upper left, dark vignette, a small yellow glow at the lantern. The faded silk tone leaves the green of the jade as the one cool colour among ochre and grey. Expression: a calm, loyal, unafraid steadiness, a guide looking back at the people he has let go ahead; a faint green hint of wood qi, softened by the fade.
